cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the WordPress WooCommerce Full-Stack Developer position, as advertised. My experience as a Junior Digital Marketer with a robust technical foundation in web development, coupled with my location in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, makes me a compelling candidate for this remote opportunity.

My current role at Episto involves full-cycle WordPress site building and maintenance for client websites, where I utilize tools like Elementor and the Astra theme for content uploads and page updates. This experience is complemented by my previous work as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, where I developed and optimized front-end features using AngularJS and JavaScript. On my personal project, mirook.com, I independently designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, demonstrating my proficiency in creating structured, functional web solutions and applying responsive design principles.

I possess extensive expertise in enhancing website performance and visibility through technical SEO audits, structured data (JSON-LD schema), and entity optimization, which I've applied to measurably improve search health scores. My ability to troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions has been honed through these projects. I am adept at tracking site performance with various analytics tools, guiding data-driven decisions for optimization.

While the CV mentions 'growing into analytics, e-commerce content management', my strong foundation in WordPress development, coupled with my problem-solving skills and computer science background, provides a solid basis for quickly mastering WooCommerce-specific integrations and backend functionalities. I am eager to contribute to building and customizing high-performing eCommerce solutions.

I am comfortable working independently, managing assigned projects, and collaborating effectively within a remote international team, including aligning with US EST business hours. My commitment to continuous improvement and delivering reliable digital solutions aligns perfectly with the demands of this role. Thank you for your time and consideration; I look forward to discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
